item.title: Ohio activists approved to start collecting signatures to repeal ban on hemp, restrictions to marijuana
item.description: Ohio activists are cleared to start collecting signatures to repeal a state law that added more criminal penalties to marijuana usage and totally banned "intoxicating" hemp products.

item.title: Gourmet hot dog restaurant Senate to close Blue Ash location at Summit Park
item.description: Senate, a popular hot dog restaurant located in Blue Ash's Summit Park, announced Tuesday that it is permanently closing its doors.

item.title: Solar farms future to be influenced by slew of meetings in Dearborn County
item.description: Two government meetings and two town halls on solar farms will pass before the end of February in Dearborn County as people call for a moratorium and the government weighs existing rules.
